subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the micrometer?
solution:
The correct answer is __Jam.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Micrometers__ are precision measuring instruments used to measure small dimensions with high accuracy.
 
• The main parts of a micrometer include the Frame, Anvil, Spindle, Sleeve, and Thimble.
 
• The Frame provides a rigid structure to hold the anvil and spindle.
 
• The Anvil and Spindle are the measuring surfaces between which the object is placed.
 
• The term Jam is NOT a part of a micrometer's components.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Thimble:**

 
 
• The thimble is a rotating part used to adjust the spindle for measurement.
 
• It has a scale engraved for precise readings.
 
 
 
• **Ratchet Stop:**
 
 
• This component ensures uniform pressure during measurement to avoid errors.
 
 
 
• **Sleeve:**
 
 
• The sleeve is a fixed cylindrical part with the main scale engraved on it.
